signal: Fiery launched JobFlow Pro and an agentic AI-powered workflow solution (Fiery Scribe) in early 2026, pushing deeper into AI-assisted print automation.

email.body1:
John, saw Fiery rolled out JobFlow Pro and the new agentic AI workflow tools this year, leaning hard into automation.

When the product story moves that fast, sales usually has more in-market accounts than the team can actually cover before momentum fades. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Fiery off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for Fiery.

Most sales teams launching new automation lines don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble to recover it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Fiery needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for Fiery.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Fiery's reply rate likely compares to peers selling into print operations. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
John, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know launching new automation products keeps the whole GTM team heads-down for a while.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales motion? I'll tailor it to Fiery either way.
